verdict.rationale: Typesense is open-source and self-hostable (Docker/K8s/binaries), and data is pushed in from your own DB/CSV/JSON, implying no proprietary lock-in of source data — but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a data-export API/format for pulling indexed data back out of a running Typesense instance. Missing for 10: documented export endpoint/tool, explicit open-format export guarantees, and confirmation of exporting from Typesense Cloud without lock-in.
